_meta.note: PROVISIONAL — CANONICAL 3-ENCOUNTER SLICE RUN (KAN-4 run engine, decision log #31; wave 3c adds the mid room). The authored demo run the RunState engine consumes verbatim: encounter 1 is the tutorial-floor brood skirmish where the party meets Sasha (staged as a party-side ally NPC — decision #31's staging default: the recruit FIGHTS the offer encounter, and joining AS-IS carries that damage), encounter 2 is the KENNEL — a war-hound pair (data/enemies.json war_hound, the second authored enemy: compendium §4.6's maze hounds, PROVISIONAL owner review) staged as the pack it is authored to be, encounter 3 is the Incine-Dile den finale with the (possibly) grown party. HYPE CHAIN FULLY LIVE (decision #32 ladder, CHAIN_RETENTION_PCT): every encounter is back-to-back, so encounter 2 OPENS at floor(40% x encounter 1's ending meter) and the finale at floor(60% x encounter 2's ending meter) — pinned by tests/test_run_state.gd + tests/test_second_enemy.gd. RECRUIT PICK — Sasha 'The Tell' over Nikita, three reasons: (1) party gap — Imani tanks on Physique 5, Dario tricks on Reflexes/Charm 5/5, nobody fields Mind; Sasha's Mind 5 is the only spread that adds a new axis to the demo pair (her own file's stated role). (2) Kit safety vs the slice boss — the Incine-Dile is Mind 1, so her feints can never be read (R24), while Nikita's bruiser kit duplicates Imani's Force role. (3) Frame fit — a casino floor manager who counted cards on her own abductors is the Cosmic Casino slice's most on-theme first recruit. Nikita stays reserved for a later den. MID-ROOM PICK — the war-hound pair: a pack-hunting Elite pair exercises a tier the slice lacked (R15 pack synergy above mob tier — a lone hound is Robustness-blocked by the tank, the linked pair bites through) and its bleeding attrition feeds the run's wounds-persist hand-offs; roach mobs stay encounter 1, the boss stays the finale. All numbers PLACEHOLDER (R14); every spec below is copied VERBATIM from its loadout source and drift-gated by tests/test_run_state.gd (test_demo_run_data_contract). WAVE 3d (KAN-5 arenas): every encounter now carries an authored 'arena' block (bounds; the den also walls + trash cans — PLACEHOLDER positions, PROVISIONAL until the owner redesigns rooms with the front). The den's 41x60 mirrors the incinedile's traits.arena_hexes design record. Arena defs LIVE HERE on the encounter def (documented decision, simulation/arena.gd header); RunState.staging() passes the block through and GameController stages set_arena before the add batch.
